name: Wisconsin YMCA Youth in Government
city: Madison, WI (Model Government), delegations across Wisconsin
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take on a role in a student model government. Write bills, argue court cases or produce media. Or run for Youth Governor. Then meet at Model Government in Madison.
who_can_apply: Students who join a delegation near them. The page read does not list grades. Media spots are by application and may be limited.
pay_detail: Dues and conference fees are not listed on the page read. Ask your delegation.
duration: Fall to March: prep, a Pre-Gov session, then the Model Government conference
deadline_text: 2026-27: Judicial, Media and Senate registration closes November 18, 2026. Assembly registration closes December 9, 2026. Pre-Gov is January 30, 2027. Model Government is March 5 to 7, 2027.
how_to_apply: Find a delegation near you on the Wisconsin YG site. Then register at wiyg.org/register before the closing date for your role. Use the Contact Us page if you need help starting a delegation.
notes: Not a job. Legislative and Media materials are due in January and Judicial materials in February.
